name: Shapes
description: A collection of all the Shape objects on the specified sheet.
remarks: Each Shape object represents an object in the drawing layer, such as an AutoShape, freeform, OLE object, or picture.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a ShapeRange object that represents a subset of the shapes in a Shapes collection.

methods.name: Item
methods.signature: Item(Index As Variant) As Shape
methods.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The name or index number for the object.

methods.name: _Default
methods.signature: _Default(Index As Variant) As Shape

methods.name: AddCallout
methods.signature: AddCallout(Type As MsoCalloutType, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a borderless line callout. Returns a Shape object that represents the new callout.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of callout line.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the callout's bounding box relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the callout's bounding box relative to the top of the document.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the callout's bounding box, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the callout's bounding box, in points.

methods.name: AddConnector
methods.signature: AddConnector(Type As MsoConnectorType, BeginX As Single, BeginY As Single, EndX As Single, EndY As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a connector. Returns a Shape object that represents the new connector. When a connector is added, it's not connected to anything. Use the BeginConnect and EndConnect methods to attach the beginning and end of a connector to other shapes in the document.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The connector type to add.

parameters.name: BeginX
parameters.description: The horizontal position (in points) of the connector's starting point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: BeginY
parameters.description: The vertical position (in points) of the connector's starting point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: EndX
parameters.description: The horizontal position (in points) of the connector's end point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: EndY
parameters.description: The vertical position (in points) of the connector's end point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

methods.name: AddCurve
methods.signature: AddCurve(SafeArrayOfPoints As Variant) As Shape
methods.description: Returns a Shape object that represents a Bzier curve on a worksheet.

parameters.name: SafeArrayOfPoints
parameters.description: An array of coordinate pairs that specifies the vertices and control points of the curve. The first point that you specify is the starting vertex, and the next two points are control points for the first Bzier segment. Then, for each additional segment of the curve, you specify a vertex and two control points. The last point that you specify is the ending vertex for the curve. Note that you must always specify 3n + 1 points, where n is the number of segments in the curve.

methods.name: AddLabel
methods.signature: AddLabel(Orientation As MsoTextOrientation, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a label. Returns a Shape object that represents the new label.

parameters.name: Orientation
parameters.description: The text orientation within the label.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the label relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the label relative to the top of the document.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the label, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the label, in points.

methods.name: AddLine
methods.signature: AddLine(BeginX As Single, BeginY As Single, EndX As Single, EndY As Single) As Shape
methods.description: As it applies to the Shapes object, returns a Shape object that represents the new line on a worksheet.

parameters.name: BeginX
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the line's starting point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: BeginY
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the line's starting point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: EndX
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the line's end point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: EndY
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the line's end point relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

methods.name: AddPicture
methods.signature: AddPicture(Filename As String, LinkToFile As MsoTriState, SaveWithDocument As MsoTriState, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a picture from an existing file. Returns a Shape object that represents the new picture.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The file from which the picture is to be created.

parameters.name: LinkToFile
parameters.description: The file to link to. Use msoFalse to make the picture an independent copy of the file. Use msoTrue to link the picture to the file from which it was created.

parameters.name: SaveWithDocument
parameters.description: To save the picture with the document. Use msoFalse to store only the link information in the document. Use msoTrue to save the linked picture with the document into which it's inserted. This argument must be msoTrue if _LinkToFile_ is msoFalse.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the picture relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the picture relative to the top of the document.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the picture, in points (enter -1 to retain the width of the existing file).

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the picture, in points (enter -1 to retain the height of the existing file).

methods.name: AddPolyline
methods.signature: AddPolyline(SafeArrayOfPoints As Variant) As Shape
methods.description: Creates an open polyline or a closed polygon drawing. Returns a Shape object that represents the new polyline or polygon.

parameters.name: SafeArrayOfPoints
parameters.description: An array of coordinate pairs that specifies the polyline drawing's vertices.

methods.name: AddShape
methods.signature: AddShape(Type As MsoAutoShapeType, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Returns a Shape object that represents the new AutoShape on a worksheet.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies the type of AutoShape to create.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the AutoShape's bounding box relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the AutoShape's bounding box relative to the top of the document.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the AutoShape's bounding box, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the AutoShape's bounding box, in points.

methods.name: AddTextEffect
methods.signature: AddTextEffect(PresetTextEffect As MsoPresetTextEffect, Text As String, FontName As String, FontSize As Single, FontBold As MsoTriState, FontItalic As MsoTriState, Left As Single, Top As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a WordArt object. Returns a Shape object that represents the new WordArt object.

parameters.name: PresetTextEffect
parameters.description: The preset text effect.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text in the WordArt.

parameters.name: FontName
parameters.description: The name of the font used in the WordArt.

parameters.name: FontSize
parameters.description: The size (in points) of the font used in the WordArt.

parameters.name: FontBold
parameters.description: The font used in the WordArt to bold.

parameters.name: FontItalic
parameters.description: The font used in the WordArt to italic.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the WordArt's bounding box relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the WordArt's bounding box relative to the top of the document.

methods.name: AddTextbox
methods.signature: AddTextbox(Orientation As MsoTextOrientation, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a text box. Returns a Shape object that represents the new text box.

parameters.name: Orientation
parameters.description: The orientation of the textbox.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the text box relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the text box relative to the top of the document.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the text box, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the text box, in points.

methods.name: BuildFreeform
methods.signature: BuildFreeform(EditingType As MsoEditingType, X1 As Single, Y1 As Single) As FreeformBuilder
methods.description: Builds a freeform object. Returns a FreeformBuilder object that represents the freeform as it is being built.

parameters.name: EditingType
parameters.description: The editing property of the first node.

parameters.name: X1
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the first node in the freeform drawing relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Y1
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the first node in the freeform drawing relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

methods.name: SelectAll
methods.signature: SelectAll()
methods.description: Selects all the shapes in the specified Shapes collection.

methods.name: AddFormControl
methods.signature: AddFormControl(Type As XlFormControl, Left As Long, Top As Long, Width As Long, Height As Long) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a Microsoft Excel control. Returns a Shape object that represents the new control.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The Microsoft Excel control type. You cannot create an edit box on a worksheet.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The initial coordinates of the new object (in points) relative to the upper-left corner of cell A1 on a worksheet or to the upper-left corner of a chart.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The initial coordinates of the new object (in points) relative to the top of row 1 on a worksheet, or to the top of the chart area on a chart.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The initial size of the new object, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The initial size of the new object, in points.

methods.name: AddOLEObject
methods.signature: AddOLEObject([ClassType As Variant], [Filename As Variant], [Link As Variant], [DisplayAsIcon As Variant], [IconFileName As Variant], [IconIndex As Variant], [IconLabel As Variant], [Left As Variant], [Top As Variant], [Width As Variant], [Height As Variant]) As Shape
methods.description: Creates an OLE object. Returns a Shape object that represents the new OLE object.

parameters.name: ClassType
parameters.description: A string that contains the programmatic identifier for the object to be created. You must specify either _ClassType_ or _FileName_. If _ClassType_ is specified, _FileName_ and _Link_ are ignored.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The file from which the object is to be created. If the path isn't specified, the current working folder is used. You must specify either the _ClassType_ or _FileName_ argument for the object, but not both.

parameters.name: Link
parameters.description: True to link the OLE object to the file from which it was created. False to make the OLE object an independent copy of the file. If you specified a value for _ClassType_, this argument must be False. The default value is False.

parameters.name: DisplayAsIcon
parameters.description: True to display the OLE object as an icon. The default value is False.

parameters.name: IconFileName
parameters.description: The file that contains the icon to be displayed.

parameters.name: IconIndex
parameters.description: The index of the icon within _IconFileName_. The order of icons in the specified file corresponds to the order in which the icons appear in the Change Icon dialog box (accessed from the Object dialog box when the Display as icon check box is selected). The first icon in the file has the index number 0 (zero). If an icon with the given index number doesn't exist in _IconFileName_, the icon with the index number 1 (the second icon in the file) is used. The default value is 0 (zero).

parameters.name: IconLabel
parameters.description: A label (caption) to be displayed beneath the icon.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the new object relative to the upper-left corner of the document. The default value is 0 (zero).

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the new object relative to the top of the document. The default value is 0 (zero).

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The initial dimensions of the OLE object, in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The initial dimensions of the OLE object, in points.

methods.name: AddSmartArt
methods.signature: AddSmartArt(Layout As SmartArtLayout, [Left As Variant], [Top As Variant], [Width As Variant], [Height As Variant]) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a new SmartArt graphic with the specified layout.

parameters.name: Layout
parameters.description: An object that represents the layout to use.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The distance, in points, from the left edge of the object to the left edge of column A (on a worksheet) or the left edge of the chart area (on a chart).

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The distance, in points, from the top edge of the object to the top edge of the worksheet.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width, in points, of the object.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height, in points, of the object.

methods.name: AddChart2
methods.signature: AddChart2([Style As Variant], [XlChartType As Variant], [Left As Variant], [Top As Variant], [Width As Variant], [Height As Variant], [NewLayout As Variant]) As Shape
methods.description: Adds a chart to the document. Returns a Shape object that represents a chart and adds it to the specified collection.

parameters.name: Style
parameters.description: The chart style. Use "-1" to get the default style for the chart type specified in XlChartType.

parameters.name: XlChartType
parameters.description: The type of chart.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, in points, of the left edge of the chart, relative to the anchor.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, in points, of the top edge of the chart, relative to the anchor.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width, in points, of the chart.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height, in points, of the chart.

parameters.name: NewLayout
parameters.description: If NewLayout is True, the chart is inserted by using the new dynamic formatting rules (Title is on, and Legend is on only if there are multiple series).

methods.name: AddPicture2
methods.signature: AddPicture2(Filename As String, LinkToFile As MsoTriState, SaveWithDocument As MsoTriState, Left As Single, Top As Single, Width As Single, Height As Single, Compress As MsoPictureCompress) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a picture from an existing file. Returns a Shape object that represents the new picture.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The file from which the OLE object is to be created.

parameters.name: LinkToFile
parameters.description: Determines whether the picture will be linked to the file from which it was created.

parameters.name: SaveWithDocument
parameters.description: Determines whether the linked picture will be saved with the document into which it is inserted. This argument must be msoTrue if _LinkToFile_ is msoFalse.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the left edge of the picture relative to the left edge of the worksheet.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position, measured in points, of the top edge of the picture relative to the top edge of the worksheet.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the picture, measured in points.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the picture, measured in points.

parameters.name: Compress
parameters.description: Determines whether the picture should be compressed when inserted.

methods.name: Add3DModel
methods.signature: Add3DModel(Filename As String, [LinkToFile As Variant], [SaveWithDocument As Variant], [Left As Variant], [Top As Variant], [Width As Variant], [Height As Variant]) As Shape
methods.description: Creates a 3D model from an existing file. Returns a Shape object that represents the new 3D model.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The file from which the 3D model is to be created.

parameters.name: LinkToFile
parameters.description: Determines whether the 3D model will be linked to the file from which it was created.

parameters.name: SaveWithDocument
parameters.description: Determines whether the linked 3D model will be saved with the document into which it is inserted.

parameters.name: Left
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the 3D model relative to the upper-left corner of the document.

parameters.name: Top
parameters.description: The position (in points) of the upper-left corner of the 3D model relative to the top of the document.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: The width of the 3D model, in points (enter -1 to auto-calculate a width based on the 3D model dimensions).

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The height of the 3D model, in points (enter -1 to auto-calculate a height based on the 3D model dimensions).
